remarks:
Welcome to this beautiful 4-bedroom, 1.5-bath home! Offering an exceptional blend of original character, thoughtful improvements, and modern conveniences, this home has so much to offer! From the moment you arrive, you’ll appreciate the  beautifully refreshed landscaping, and brand-new Trex front porch.

Step inside to discover gorgeous refinished hardwood floors, beautiful original woodwork, and spacious, light-filled living areas. The removal of a wall in the living room creates a more open and inviting floor plan, allowing for a seamless flow between living spaces. Brand-new triple-pane windows throughout the home bring in abundant natural light while enhancing energy efficiency. The kitchen features brand-new appliances, and a functional space with the opportunity to add your own personal touches and updates.

The extensive list of major improvements is truly impressive! Enjoy peace of mind with a brand-new high-efficiency furnace and central air conditioning system, tankless hot water heater, updated 200-amp electrical panel, completely new electrical service from the street to the home, brand-new sump pump, and a whole-home generator for reliability.

Step outside to your own private backyard retreat! The fully fenced yard features beautiful new landscaping, a relaxing hot tub, patio area perfect for entertaining, and a brand-new storage shed. Whether you’re hosting gatherings, enjoying a quiet evening outdoors, or simply relaxing in the hot tub, this backyard offers something for everyone.

With four bedrooms, one and a half bathrooms, beautiful hardwood floors, spacious living areas, and an incredible number of major upgrades already completed, this home offers the perfect opportunity to enjoy modern comfort while adding your own finishing touches. This home provides plenty of space and an excellent opportunity to bring your own vision to life with cosmetic updates to the kitchen and bathrooms. A wonderful combination of character, efficiency, and outdoor enjoyment—this is one you won’t want to miss! Seller reserves the right to set a deadline.
